skills.description: Turn a short product or engineering request into an implementable specification with explicit constraints, user flows, states, contracts, acceptance criteria, and phased delivery.
Audit supplied code or a repository for correctness, security, reliability, maintainability, and framework-specific issues, with evidence, severity, and actionable fixes.
Control AI-agent tool use through intent checks, preflight planning, least privilege, confirmation gates, bounded retries, and post-action verification.
Produce grounded analysis and research by separating facts, inferences, hypotheses, and unknowns; verifying material claims and identifying source quality.
Reduce repeated explanations and prompt-writing by reusing available conversation or project context, making low-risk assumptions explicit, and asking only for essential missing information.
Maintain accurate project continuity by extracting constraints and decisions from authoritative project sources, detecting stale context, and producing compact handoffs without inventing status.
